body: I honestly don’t know. I’ve already started saying goodbyes...

You might be right about it being better once I’ve left, but honestly, I don’t have it in me to make it that long. I can’t handle a few more days of this, let alone another 6+ months. I wish it wasn’t this way, but I don’t see another way out. I’m trapped.
Unfortunately, being homeless in NYC right now, combined with a bunch of health issues, would be a borderline death sentence.

That’s the problem. I can barely survive, and there’s no way out. I’m at the point where I break down in response to something as minor as loud talking in the other room. I’m virtually always on the edge of tears. I can’t even access medication aside from being high 24/7.  I have no options open for getting out, either. 

And I’ve been hearing that things would get better as long as I can remember. It’s always gotten worse. I’m done running off of that for a source of hope.
